description: Add a task. Times written in plain language inside the title are understood: "call Sam 2pm" schedules itself for 2pm and the user is reminded beforehand. So are repeats: "gym every weekday at 6pm" sets up a repeating task, which appears one day at a time. Pass dueAt or repeat only to override what the title says.

dueAt.description: ISO-8601 time, if you need to be explicit.

repeat.description: Makes this a repeating task. Usually unnecessary: a title like "gym every weekday at 6pm" is read for you. Pass this only to be explicit.

interval.description: Every N days or weeks. Defaults to 1.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the last day. Omit for no end.

name: add_task
